title: Former KKR Managing Director Jigar Shah appointed HDFC Bank General Counsel
description: HDFC Bank has approved the appointment of former KKR Managing Director Jigar Shah as its General Counsel.The bank informed the stock exchanges on June 29 that Shah has been appointed as General Counsel-Designate with effect from August 20, 2026.
